_meta.note: country blocks located from row-6 headers; % Patients Receiving carried but NOT applied by the workbook engine

Nigeria.source: Country clinical-pathway estimates (validated Sep 2026); % care provision folded into minutes (MO 33.5%, PN 26.6%, Psychiatrist 31%, SR 35.5%). LAI visits/yr = injection schedule per the settled rule — the drafts' 9 monitoring visits/yr on injectable rows is recorded as a validation question for the Nigeria country team. No separate screening visit — folded into the prescription visit per the draft design.

Rwanda.source: Country clinical-pathway estimates (validated Sep 2026); % care provision folded into minutes (oral rows: Psychiatric Nurse and Clinical Psychologist at 50%). Injectable/LAI rows use the tertiary providers present in the drafts (Psychiatric Nurse + Psychiatrist — the Rwanda tertiary-care pathway design); nurse attendance aligned to the injection schedule; to be confirmed by the country team. LAI visits/yr = injection schedule per the settled rule. No separate screening visit. Psychiatric nurse time per LAI injection visit set to 30 min on 18 Sep 2026 (Rwanda clinical pathway outline, 19 Aug 2026: about 30 min for mental status, side effects and vitals, then the injection; psychiatrist 10 min per visit unchanged). Initiation stays 52.5 min. Short-acting IM rows keep 52.5 pending validation.

South Africa.source: Country clinical-pathway estimates (validated Sep 2026); % care provision folded into minutes (Psychiatrist 43.75%, PN 34%, GP 100%, GN 66%); block applied uniformly across products (clinical adviser: same pathway) — minor % care-provision estimates pending (clinical adviser), immaterial (amber). LAI visits/yr = injection schedule per the settled rule. No separate screening visit.
